How does the Hair Growth Pack work? The Advanced Hair Growth Pack contains Hair Gummies and Rosemary Hair Growth Roll-On. Our Hair Gummies contain essential multivitamins like Biotin, Zinc, and Vitamin A, C, and E that are crucial building blocks of hair and help curb hair fall. Our all natural Hair Growth Roll-On contains plant-based actives that stimulate hair follicles leading to hair growth. What is Biotin? Our hair is made of a protein called Keratin. Having sufficient keratin is important to keep the hair strong. Biotin (B7) helps in keratin synthesis. It's a vital supplement for hair loss treatment. How does Zinc help in hair fall? Zinc plays an important role in hair tissue growth and repair. Having Zinc supplements help treat hair loss caused by insufficient zinc. How is Hair Growth Roll On different than serums?
